content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-webhook-driven-14|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-9|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-every-detail-you-2|cloudflare]] Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is about owning and controlling one's digital commerce stack. It means not relying on third-party platforms that can restrict access or charge exorbitant fees. For digital creators in Kenya, this infrastructure is crucial as it provides a way to sell ebooks and other digital products without the need for Stripe or PayPal. It's about having the freedom to conduct business without unnecessary restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind sovereign commerce infrastructure is built around automated delivery and crypto payment processing. Tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages handle hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic. For payment processing, services like NOWPayments offer a seamless way to accept cryptocurrency, converting it to USD at transaction time. This setup ensures that digital creators can focus on producing content rather than worrying about the technical aspects of selling it.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who have been locked out by traditional payment platforms. In regions like Kenya, where access to Stripe and PayPal is limited, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a viable alternative. It's for those who want to maintain control over their business, without the fear of sudden account freezes or exorbitant transaction fees. It's about empowering creators to sell their products—ebooks, courses, templates, and more—on their own terms.
Empower your digital sales with sovereign infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages, backend logic tools such as Cloudflare Workers, and payment processing services like NOWPayments. Each component plays a critical role in ensuring that the ecommerce stack functions smoothly. For instance, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and offers automatic on-chain payment verification, making it a robust solution for accepting crypto payments. Understanding how these components work together is essential for deploying an effective sovereign commerce infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today, digital creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. This might involve choosing a hosting platform, setting up backend logic, and integrating a payment processing service. With the right guidance, creators can have a fully operational online store with automated ebook delivery and crypto payment processing. This not only streamlines the sales process but also ensures that creators maintain full control and ownership of their business and data.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your ebook delivery with crypto payments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For digital creators in Kenya and similar regions, the Complete Builder Kit is a valuable resource. It provides the tools and knowledge needed to overcome the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms, enabling creators to focus on what they do best: producing high-quality digital content.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate a payment processing service like NOWPayments, configure automated delivery for digital products, and test the entire setup to ensure seamless functionality. With these steps, digital creators can establish a robust and independent ecommerce platform.
